finding_text_ko: 주기적 확인시험(confirmatory testing)을 실시하지 않았다.

finding_text: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions.
finding_text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·필수 시험·보관 및/또는 유통(각각의 조건 포함)에 관한 증빙의 유지관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적 교육이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 포장 후 및/또는 수입자 시설에 입고된 후 각 의약품 배치의 확인 식별이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The retention time for records was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 보관기간이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The master production documents were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 제조지시서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
